summary: Adds line items to an existing Direct Issue.
description: Adds line items to an existing Draft Direct Issue. Send item_id to add one inventory material, requirement_line_id to add that Requirement line, or requirement_id to add every Requirement line that is not already linked and can be issued. A Requirement line can be issued when it has soft-allocated Quantity Available and acceptable stock at a location. requirement_line_id is rejected with ZERO_QUANTITY when the line cannot be issued; requirement_id skips those lines and is rejected with ZERO_QUANTITY only when no line can be added. The same material may be added once per Requirement line. The response is the lines that were added.
